# ADR 0002: Detection logic as versioned SQL scenarios

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** AML transaction monitoring

## Context

Typologies are set-based patterns over large windows; compliance needs to read and review them.

## Decision

One SQL file per scenario with named parameters, executed via JdbcClient; thresholds and versions stored on each alert.

## Consequences

Fast, reviewable and testable on fixtures; requires strong SQL and indexing skills.

## Alternatives considered

Java loops over millions of rows.
